verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API, so offering embeddings and reranking is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents only chat completions, the Responses API, audio transcription, structured outputs, tool use, batch processing and LoRA. Nothing in the pack mentions an embeddings endpoint or a reranking capability, so a retrieval pipeline would still need a second vendor.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor
